mechanism_narrative: Sustained suppression of TRANSIT below -20% prevents retail trips, so RETAIL_REC remains below its recent mean over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days despite TRANSIT remaining below -20% for the entire period.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS mobility drops below -20% (indicating closure or avoidance of public spaces due to restrictions), retail and recreation footfall declines further over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: After PARKS falls below -20%, RETAIL_REC over the following two weeks is not lower than the two weeks prior.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of negative WORKPLACES and positive RESIDENTIAL indicates widespread work-from-home, which reduces weekday retail footfall, driving RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: When WORKPLACES < -5% and RESIDENTIAL > 3% simultaneously, RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not lower than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: In a lockdown regime (defined by GROCERY_PHARM > 3% and TRANSIT < -20%), rising grocery/pharmacy mobility signals stockpiling of essentials, which crowds out retail and recreation spending, pushing RETAIL_REC down over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: In weeks where GROCERY_PHARM > 3% and TRANSIT < -20%, RETAIL_REC over the following two weeks is not lower than the two weeks prior.

mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC exhibits mean reversion: after a week with RETAIL_REC below its four-week mean, the next week tends to rebound. Following the recent drop to -8.9%, a rebound is expected, driving RETAIL_REC higher over the next week.
failure_condition: After a week where RETAIL_REC is below its four-week mean, the next week's RETAIL_REC is not higher in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT rises above -20% (indicating easing of restrictions and return of commuting), retail and recreation mobility will increase over the next two weeks as people resume shopping and leisure activities.
failure_condition: After TRANSIT rises above -20%, RETAIL_REC over the following two weeks is not higher than the two weeks prior.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS is very low and GROCERY_PHARM is rising, it indicates that people are avoiding outdoor leisure and focusing on essential shopping, which reduces retail and recreation footfall over the next week.
failure_condition: When PARKS < -15% and GROCERY_PHARM > 3% simultaneously, RETAIL_REC over the next week is not lower than the previous week.

mechanism_narrative: Seasonal heat in Delhi during May reduces outdoor activity, as reflected in low PARKS mobility, which in turn reduces retail and recreation footfall over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: During May, when PARKS is below -10%, RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not lower than over the last 28 days.
